answer: A payout is split so that 33% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The reef schedule is applied in ledge and juniper exposes each instalment. A hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1000 identities would post 4689 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
